verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a software-backed SaaS platform with an API, so asking whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence mentions a source repository, an open license, or source availability. The docs cover only hosted mailbox services, an API and a Zapier integration, none of which amounts to open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
